method: Stored report occurrence counts on explicit property:house rows. Joint bounds refer to these reported direct fields only. Marginals can include nonpositive values. Lot/value lower bounds use max of alternative columns. Held labels, mapped lots, confidential exclusions, untyped houses, source semantics and eligible houses missing from storage require independent checks before switching. Suffolk totals cover its entire stored county, while the municipal gate serves Boston only.
